candidate_title: Pre-divergence admissible-option collapse predicts persistent endpoint memory effects after transport and earliest-action mediation fail
scientific_role: zero-authority exact-reduction falsifier before any method design or new GPU rollout
hypothesis: Before the first retrieved-versus-placebo action divergence, a lower fraction of currently admissible commands whose deterministic action skeleton appears in the retrieved memory procedure predicts a nonzero controlled memory effect beyond same-information task/context, source-target relation, state phase, first-action-family, divergence-timing, and total-admissible-count controls.

frozen_split.outcome: controlled_delta != 0 where controlled_delta is retrieved_success - placebo_success

pre_outcome_feature_contract.prefix_definition: longest common prefix of retrieved and placebo historical action sequences
pre_outcome_feature_contract.memory_consistent_command: an admissible ALFWorld command whose deterministic action skeleton exactly matches a skeleton appearing in the frozen source-memory procedure; movable object identity is wildcarded while action verb and receptacle/appliance/landmark type are preserved
pre_outcome_feature_contract.candidate_feature: memory_consistent_fraction = matching_admissible_commands / total_admissible_commands at the reconstructed pre-divergence state
pre_outcome_feature_contract.candidate_score_direction: collapse predicts effect, so lower memory_consistent_fraction corresponds to higher predicted probability of nonzero controlled effect

same_information_baseline.model: fixed pure-Python class-balanced L2 logistic regression with deterministic full-batch gradient descent

optimizer.categorical_encoding: sorted train-vocabulary one-hot with unknown test categories all-zero
